description: This file defines a data structure 'ShareGatewayRelayConfig' and a utility enum 'ShareGatewayRelaySettings' that manages configuration data for a relay gateway, including saving, loading, and clearing configurations and events using UserDefaults.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads the relay configuration from UserDefaults, decoding it from JSON data.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Encodes and saves the relay configuration to UserDefaults.

methods.name: clearConfig
methods.description: Removes the relay configuration from UserDefaults.

methods.name: saveLastEvent
methods.description: Saves the last event message with a timestamp into UserDefaults.

methods.name: loadLastEvent
methods.description: Retrieves the last event message from UserDefaults and returns it if available.
